info.title: OlmoEarth Studio API
info.description:
## Interactive API Browser

If you're not already using it, visit the [interactive API documentation](https://docs.olmoearth.allenai.org/api/) for the best
experience.

## Authentication

To authenticate API requests, you'll need an API token from OlmoEarth Studio:

1. Log into [OlmoEarth Studio](https://olmoearth.allenai.org)
2. Click the menu icon in the top right corner and select **My Profile**
3. Copy your API key using the copy button
4. Include the token in the `Authorization` header as a bearer token:
   ```
   Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
   ```
   If you're using the interactive API documentation, simply paste your token in the **Authentication** box to the
   right.

post.description:
Create a new area from GeoJSON Geometry.

Accepts a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry.
Areas must be polygons (or collections of polygons) as they represent spatial regions for inference.

project_id is required; the area's organization is taken from that project.

Authorization:
- Studio admins can create areas in any project they can access
- Project admins can create areas in accessible projects

get.description:
Get a single area by ID.

Returns the area with its full GeoJSON geometry.

put.description:
Update an existing Area record (name, geometry, and/or organization_id).

Authorization:
- If organization_id is being changed, validates user has access to the new organization

delete.description:
Delete an area.

Raises an error if the area is used in any predictions to prevent accidental data loss.

post.description:
Search for areas with advanced filtering.

Supports filtering by id, name, organization_id, creation_time, updated_time, and geospatial queries.
Returns area records without geometries for improved performance.
Use GET /areas/{area_id} to retrieve a single area with its geometry.

Authorization:
- Studio admins can search all areas (optionally filter by organization_id)
- Project admins can only search areas in their organizations

post.description:
Search for labels with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

Supports filtering by template_id, labelset_id, and label id.
Access is scoped by role:
    - Studio admins can search all labels
- Project admins can search labels in their organizations' projects
- Users can only search labels in projects they are assigned to

Permissions.title: Permissions
Permissions.description:
The full permission vocabulary — what a caller may do.

Most members reach a user through their role, via studio's `ROLE_PERMISSIONS`.
`UserBase.additional_permissions` carries only the ones granted to a person directly.

Members are stored as raw strings on the user row and travel in the JWT, so changing a
value requires migrating stored data.
